bugs.rationale:
RUSTSEC-2020-0044: Atom

's Send / Sync impls require only `P: IntoRawPtr + FromRawPtr`, NOT `P: Send`. Combined with the swap-based AtomicPtr API, this lets a non-Send P (e.g. one whose inner ptr is to thread-local data, or one carrying a !Send Drop side effect) be moved across threads -- two threads can race on the inner pointer's drop / reinit. Fixed in 0.3.6 by adding the missing `P: Send` bound.
